items.label: Profile
items.content: XR and gaming-engine developer who takes immersive prototypes from vision to production-ready systems in Unity. Shipped a commercial free-roam VR product (Adventure Portal) that piloted at the Telus World of Science (4.84/5, NPS 84) and now distributes across 400+ VR arcades, and built real-time 3D training simulators and AR tools for institutional clients through rapid, Agile prototyping. Works in C# and Python across virtual, augmented, and mixed reality, collaborates closely with artists and designers, and is eager to apply real-time 3D to digital-twin, sensor, and edge-computing problems.

jobs.title: Fractional Technical Program Head
bullets: Built ELIXR's entire XR development and rapid-prototyping stack from scratch: reusable project templates and tooling, build pipelines, testing and evaluation workflows, documentation, SOPs, and hiring systems.
Lead end-to-end discovery and prototyping for institutional clients, turning ambiguous requirements into working demonstrations on tight timelines.
Continuously evaluate emerging XR, computer-vision, and AI tools, building targeted prototypes to validate feasibility, performance, and usability before production commitment.
Mentor XR junior developers and artists, and set the SOPs the team uses for rapid prototyping across AR/VR/MR.

**City of Calgary, WAVE Technology Centre:** delivered four proof-of-concept XR prototypes (VR training, mixed-reality, smart-glasses reporting, 360 video) from scoping through stakeholder evaluation.
**Red Deer Polytechnic & Alberta Sports Hall of Fame:** led the team integrating OpenCV computer-vision tracking with a real-time Unity simulation for a permanent wheelchair-curling installation.
**Northern Alberta Institute of Technology:** built an AI-enabled VR nursing simulator (SBAR communication protocol) with a real-time AI loop grading communication proficiency.
**Edmonton Chinatown Heritage Association:** built a phone-based AR app where users scan historic murals to reveal 3D animations and unlock local-business rewards.

header.name: Brayden Clark
header.title: XR & Gaming Engine Developer · Real-Time 3D · Unity · VR/AR/MR

body: I'm applying for the XR Developer role because taking immersive prototypes from vision to production-ready systems is exactly the work I do. I build in Unity across VR, AR, and mixed reality, and I'm drawn to the intersection of XR, digital twin, and edge computing this team is pushing into.

I ship. Adventure Portal, a real-time multiplayer Unity VR experience I built, piloted at the Telus World of Science (4.84/5 satisfaction, NPS 84) and is now distributed across a 400+ VR arcade network, a shipped commercial XR product end to end. Through rapid, Agile prototyping I've also delivered real-time 3D training simulators, mixed-reality tools, and AR applications for institutional clients, working shoulder to shoulder with artists and designers and managing the full lifecycle from scoping to deployment. I work in C# and Python and pick up new engines, SDKs, and toolchains fast.

What excites me about Booz Allen is the chance to apply that real-time 3D and rapid-prototyping experience to harder, higher-stakes problems, digital twins, sensors and IoT, and 5G/edge, alongside a team that values ingenuity and customer outcomes. I'd welcome the opportunity to contribute and to keep learning at that frontier.
